In detail

San Fermin has moderate, credible documentation: in June 2025 a suspected narcopiso was exposed when paramedics responding to a sick baby found the home saturated with marijuana odor, and neighbours described constant unfamiliar foot traffic. Separately, a 2019 residents' association report on the barrio's 'Zona Mezquita' documented complaints of robberies of homes, cars and pedestrians, and poor street lighting contributing to insecurity, especially after dark. Sources checked: Telemadrid, Jun 2025; Asociacion Vecinal San Fermin, 2019 report.

Madrid publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is San Fermín safe?

Wandroz currently rates San Fermín in Madrid as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Madrid during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Madrid at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Madrid publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is San Fermín safe at night?

At night, San Fermín is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Madrid. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is San Fermín a good area to stay in as a tourist?

San Fermín's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Madrid) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Is there official crime data for San Fermín?

Not an official government crime feed — San Fermín's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used). An absence of recent negative coverage is treated as inconclusive, not as proof the area is safe. If you live in or know San Fermín well, you can suggest a correction using the link below.
